faq_heading: Homes near Frank Hurt Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Frank Hurt Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Frank Hurt Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Frank Hurt Secondary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Frank Hurt Secondary sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 256 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,341,130, townhomes $666,500, condos $486,500. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Frank Hurt Secondary?
faq.a: Within 2 km of Frank Hurt Secondary the median was 32 days on the market, closing at 97.0% of the list price, with 14% of sales above the list price for the 256 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Frank Hurt Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Bear Creek Elementary (0.7 km north-west), Guru Angad Dev School (0.9 km west) and M B Sanford Elementary (1.1 km south-east).

Frank Hurt Secondary is a secondary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 13940 77 Ave. It teaches grades 8 to 12.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Frank Hurt Secondary, followed by what homes within 2 km of the school sold for.
How the Frank Hurt Secondary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Frank Hurt Secondary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 2 km of Frank Hurt Secondary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 256 homes sold within 2 km of Frank Hurt Secondary: 93 houses, 84 townhomes and 66 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,341,130.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Frank Hurt Secondary

27 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Frank Hurt Secondary in a straight line (21 elementary, 3 other, 3 secondary; 5 independent). The closest is Bear Creek Elementary, 0.7 km away, and the farthest on this list is Cindrich Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Enver Creek Secondary (1.9 km); the nearest independent school is Guru Angad Dev School (0.9 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Ecole Panorama Ridge Secondary (3.0 km). Other secondary schools close by: Enver Creek Secondary (1.9 km north-east), Princess Margaret Secondary (2.4 km south-west), Ecole Panorama Ridge Secondary (3.0 km south-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (8-12) is Enver Creek Secondary, 1.9 km north-east of Frank Hurt Secondary.
